purpose: Semantic evaluation of source-local uncertainty versus validated evidence. Not executable offline proof or human labels; evaluate observer, writer and reviewer against supplied observations.

cases.buyer: Какой коврик подходит именно к UNIT-A?

facts.evidence: For UNIT-A install mat MAT-A; for UNIT-B use MAT-B.

coverage.evidence: Compound claim not proved by one passage

warnings: Manufacturer product page did not name the mat

criteria: Name MAT-A as the manual-supported mat for UNIT-A without demanding another separate compatibility statement.
Do not assert unproved usage conditions or source authority.
Reviewer flags a categorical statement that no suitable mat has been confirmed, referencing the validated passage.
Observer does not repeat investigation solely because unrelated or broader claims failed.

cases.buyer: Какой коврик подходит именно к UNIT-A?
criteria: No fabricated part number or compatibility.
Continue a reasonable available read; if no budget remains, name the precise unknown without asserting incompatibility or exhausted sources.

sources.evidence: MAT-A must not be installed on UNIT-A.

criteria: Preserve real contradiction and research its applicability/version instead of choosing the positive value.
Do not apply the no-evidence-is-not-negative rule to erase explicit negative evidence.
Do not transfer compatibility from UNIT-B to UNIT-A.
Report target compatibility as unconfirmed, not established incompatibility.
